source.applied_sections: Acceptance criteria, validation scope, SOH/EFC and scoring definitions only

curve_policy: Both limits must pass for every independent validation cell; no pooled average can hide a failed cell

eol.unset_bracket_policy: If a crossing exists, defer EOL acceptance until measurement resolution is justified. Without a crossing, mark not_evaluated. Never extrapolate measured EOL.

scope.stage1: Independent cell with same measured condition as calibration
scope.stage2: At least one independent untrained temperature or SOC condition with parameters fixed
scope.unavailable_additional_condition: Report same-condition-only scope; do not declare stage2 complete
scope.generalization: Only evaluated cells and conditions; no all-temperature, all-SOC or all-charge-rate claim

certification: Metric scoring does not itself certify physical model validity, voltage, temperature, SOC, safety or pack performance
